name: Light's Chosen lowers the target's effective resistance by 10% of Intellect
contract: Light's Chosen 301310 reads '... and your spell penetration by $s3% of your Intellect.' ($s3 = 10, EffectBasePoints[2] 9). Its effect 2 triggers 301369 (aura 123 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, misc 126), whose amount AscensionTemplarAuras.cpp sets from $s3 and Intellect. A level 60 Templar with Greatness 60234 (Intellect 332) reads back, with no hit applied, the average resist Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance gives its Holy and Shadow spells on a level 60 dummy (entry 36): CoA.MonsterResistance gives the dummy 60 x PerLevel 1.0 = 60 resistance, 60 / PerPercent 5 = 12%. 33 penetration (int32(33.2)) leaves 27, 5.4%. A positive amount added 33 instead: 93, 18.6%. This is a readback; the behaviour proof (+7.5% Holy damage on that dummy) is separate.

steps.label: Without Light's Chosen the level 60 dummy keeps 60 Holy resistance, 12%
Light's Chosen's penetration aura is held
33 penetration leaves the dummy 27 Holy resistance, 5.4%
The penetration covers every magic school: Shadow 27 as well
Without the aura the dummy is back at 60, 12%
